title: Among Us: Measuring and Mitigating Malicious Contributions in Model Collaboration Systems
reasoning: The paper benchmarks model safety and malicious behavior in multi-LLM systems. It utilizes datasets like SafetyBench and CocoNot to evaluate the 'maliciousness' of models, which is defined through personas that lack honesty, equity, and empathy, and exhibit unethical behavior. This constitutes a benchmarking of ethical alignment and moral behavior within AI systems.
